name: 深夜蓝超薄轻金属笔记本款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果缩略图里一眼赢下点击，交代薄机身与窄边框大屏比例。
用正俯视的整版键盘与大触控板布局，交代打字工作面与比例。
用立于暗场的处理器芯片与青色光晕微距，把算力叙事留成一枚可替换的空印章。
shots.textZone: upper rail for 「{selling_point_1}」, lower rail for 「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 用四台合盖侧颜自上而下堆出的薄边色谱，让买家按颜色挑款。
用上下两条侧边特写与空白引线，交代磁吸口与高速接口的排布。
用一台展屏机加三枚留白功能卡，把影像与声音卖点排成可替换清单。
把薄机放进窗边扶手椅的膝上黄昏光影，完成移动办公的自我代入。
用四象限留白能力格把智能、协同与配置叙事排成可自填的版式。
收口信任，用俯视三件套点名版式交代整机与充电配件的盒内含量。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless cool white #F4F5F7 field for figure and deck frames, one near-black slate stage #141B24 reserved for the chip macro, pale card grids #FFFFFF with hairline dividers for feature and inventory screens, warm interior dusk light only inside the single lifestyle frame
style.direction: clinical premium thin-and-light laptop commerce, cool white stages and anodized metal
style.iconSystem: thin ink line glyphs (camera, waveform, sound rings) above blank two-line rails, hairline leader lines with flat terminals, no interface screenshots with readable text, no brand marks
style.lightingSystem: sterile even studio light near 6800K, long soft gradient travelling across anodized metal, crisp micro-shadow under each key cap, one teal halo rim on the chip only, warm window sun confined to the lifestyle frame
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clinical premium thin-and-light laptop ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cool white field #F4F5F7, deep space blue shell #2E3B4E, starlight silver #E8E6E1 and lake-blue accent #7FA8C9; sterile even studio light near 6800K with a long soft gradient across anodized metal, crisp micro-shadows under key caps and a teal halo reserved for the chip macro; white fields, one near-black slate stage for the chip, pale hairline card grids and warm interior dusk only in the single lifestyle frame; one calm grotesque in ink kept as empty placeholder rails; thin line glyphs above blank rails; blank dark glass screens and unmarked lids; no color palette changes, no readable screen content, no brand logos, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no brand logos on lid or chip
style.presentationRules: the laptop screen is always a blank dark glass with no wallpaper or interface, the lid exterior stays unmarked with no logo, ports shown empty, people generic and softened
style.surfaceSystem: matte anodized aluminium, black key well with low-relief caps, glass trackpad sheen, frosted chip mirror, smooth white card boards, no wood desk surfaces except the lifestyle frame
style.typography: one calm grotesque in ink #1F2937, every headline, port label, caption and stat slot kept as an empty placeholder
